# design-os-svg-animation

> Deterministic vector animation and 1080p 60fps motion video pipeline for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity). Motion IR compiler, virtual clock quantizing, and 5 anti-flop verification gates.

A motion engineering pipeline that compiles Motion IR storyboards to CSS and GSAP, renders broadcast MP4s with headless Chromium virtual clocks, and audits output against 5 anti-flop gates.

## Documentation

- [Overview & Showcase](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/): Interactive landing page with live animations and video showcase.
- [Motion IR Specification](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/motion-ir.html): Full specification for the intermediate representation.
- [Architecture Overview](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/architecture-overview.html): Multi-stage video rendering pipeline and virtual clock mechanism.
- [Quality & Safety Gates](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/quality-and-safety-gates.html): The 5 deterministic anti-flop validation criteria.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-svg-animation): Source code, CLI commands, and test suites.

## Core Features & Workflow

- **Motion IR**: JSON intermediate representation capturing keyframes, easings, spatial trajectories, and timeline markers.
- **Virtual Clock Engine**: Drives headless Chromium via explicit timestamp increments (1/60s), eliminating dropped frames.
- **5 Anti-Flop Gates**: Frame drift, color gamut, bounds overflow, font loading, and timeline integrity audits.
